_description: Curated AI-specific threat intelligence — OWASP LLM Top 10, MCP supply chain, public model-poisoning incidents. Refreshed by hand or by re-running seed_ai_threat_intel() from app.py at startup. Supplements vuln_db.json (which targets traditional Python/NPM dependency CVEs).
_source_of_record: Updated when a major AI-specific disclosure is reported.

categories.owasp_llm_top10: OWASP LLM Top 10 reference incidents — pattern-level guidance, not single-CVE
categories.mcp_supply_chain: MCP ecosystem advisories — bad servers, registry poisoning, fingerprint drift
categories.model_supply_chain: Hugging Face / vendor model-side compromises and poisoning
categories.framework_advisory: LangChain / LangGraph / CrewAI / Autogen advisory feed
categories.agent_tooling: AI agent tool ecosystem (Lakera, Protect AI, HiddenLayer published research)

advisories.title: LLM01: Prompt Injection
advisories.summary: Adversarial prompts that override system instructions or manipulate tool calls. Direct (user input) and indirect (tool result, retrieved doc, database field) variants. Mitigation: input scanning + output validation + tool permission scoping. ACP coverage: Q4 InjectionFirewall.

advisories.title: LLM02: Insecure Output Handling
advisories.summary: Downstream systems treating LLM output as trusted (XSS, SQL injection, RCE). Mitigation: encode output, parameterise queries, sandbox tool execution. ACP coverage: Q5 ContentScanner + Q11 ToolPermissions.

advisories.title: LLM03: Training Data Poisoning
advisories.summary: Malicious training / fine-tuning data inserts backdoors or biases. Mitigation: dataset provenance, eval-pack canaries, drift detection. ACP coverage: Q14 DriftDetector.

advisories.title: LLM04: Model Denial of Service
advisories.summary: Resource-exhaustion via large prompts, recursive tool calls, or token bombing. Mitigation: rate limits, iteration caps, cost budgets. ACP coverage: Q1 LoopGuard + Q7 CostGate.

advisories.title: LLM05: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
advisories.summary: Compromised models, libraries, or MCP servers. Includes typosquatting and registry poisoning. Mitigation: pin versions, verify hashes, allowlist registries. ACP coverage: Q36 MCPServerTrust + VulnOps.

advisories.title: LLM06: Sensitive Information Disclosure
advisories.summary: PII or proprietary data leaks via LLM responses, tool outputs, or memory. Mitigation: output PII scanning + redaction, memory hygiene, role-scoped retrieval. ACP coverage: Q3 PIIScanner + Q5 ContentScanner.

advisories.title: LLM07: Insecure Plugin Design
advisories.summary: Plugins / tools that accept free-form input without validation, or grant excessive scopes. Mitigation: typed parameters, least-privilege tool grants. ACP coverage: Q11 ToolPermissions + Q12 ApprovalGate.

advisories.title: LLM08: Excessive Agency
advisories.summary: Agent granted tools or privileges beyond what its task requires. Mitigation: tier-scoped autonomy, HITL for high-blast actions. ACP coverage: Q8 AutonomyTier + Q12 ApprovalGate.

advisories.title: LLM09: Overreliance
advisories.summary: Treating LLM output as ground truth in safety-critical decisions. Mitigation: human review on high-risk outputs, hallucination detection, citation grounding. ACP coverage: Q9 HallucinationGuard.

advisories.title: LLM10: Model Theft
advisories.summary: Unauthorised extraction of model weights or query-based reconstruction. Mitigation: rate limits, watermarking, query monitoring. ACP coverage: rate-limit envelopes via gateway.

advisories.title: GPT-Researcher MCP-STDIO unauthenticated UI injection
advisories.summary: MCP server allows arbitrary command execution via crafted tool-call JSON. RCE on any host running the GPT-Researcher stack. Part of the 'Mother of All Supply Chains' architectural flaw.

advisories.title: LiteLLM MCP registry poisoning + RCE
advisories.summary: Attacker can inject a malicious MCP server through the registry layer and achieve RCE. Vendor initially declined as 'by design'; reclassified after public disclosure.

advisories.title: Hugging Face: malicious pickle payloads in shared model cards
advisories.summary: Models distributed via .pkl / pickle.load() execute arbitrary code on download. Protect AI's scanner has flagged thousands of such uploads since 2024. Mitigation: load via safetensors, scan with Protect AI Guardian / huggingface-pickle-scan.

advisories.title: Indirect prompt injection via PDF metadata + retrieval
advisories.summary: Lakera's red-team research demonstrates RAG pipelines pulling PDFs with adversarial metadata that hijack downstream agent behaviour. Mitigation: scan retrieved docs for injection patterns BEFORE concatenation into the prompt.

advisories.title: Trojan MCP servers in unverified registries
advisories.summary: HiddenLayer flagged multiple MCP servers in npm + PyPI that masquerade as legitimate but call out to attacker-controlled endpoints during tool execution. Mitigation: pin MCP servers via ACP MCPServerTrust + sandbox new MCPs before production attach.

advisories.title: LangChain Python REPL tool RCE
advisories.summary: Default LangChain Python REPL tool (PythonREPLTool) accepts arbitrary code execution from agent reasoning. Multi-CVE class — patched in chains since v0.0.300 but legacy code paths still ship in many in-house wrappers.
